method: OpenAlex works/<B>?select=referenced_works, membership test of A's OpenAlex id; manual checks of publisher reference lists where noted

codes.NOT-IN-REFS: A not in B's OpenAlex referenced_works

codes.VARIANT: B cites a different version or predecessor of A (see note)
